LanguageData.Gun_ChainShotgun.label: AA-12 CQC
LanguageData.Gun_ChainShotgun.description: The AA-12 CQC is a fully automatic shotgun designed for close-quarters combat. It delivers a rapid barrage of shots, making it ideal for situations where sheer firepower is needed at close range. Built with a robust frame, this weapon prioritizes reliability and ease of use, allowing even less experienced shooters to effectively manage its intense output.
